title: plugins live omp
brief:
This is a measurement task for the aos runner's Pi plugin support, not a feature task. Do every step below, in order, exactly as written. There is no reduced or shortened form of this task: a skipped step fails it. Create the file PROOF.md at the repository root and fill it as the steps say. Change no other file. Do not retry a refused or failed step: record its exact text and go on to the next step. Use the bash tool for every shell step.

1. Tool. If a tool or a device named `probe_echo` is available to you, call it once with the text `hello-from-the-desk` and write its exact result under a heading `## tool` in PROOF.md. Otherwise write `NO-TOOL: <the names of the tools you do have>` there.
2. Skill. A skill named `proof-skill` is installed for you. Read its SKILL.md and copy its line that starts with `Code phrase:` exactly, under `## skill` in PROOF.md.
3. Extension block. Run this bash command by itself: `echo EXT-DENY-ME`. It may be blocked before it runs. Under `## ext-deny` in PROOF.md, write the exact block text, or the command's output if it ran.
4. Subagent. If you have a tool for subagents named `task` or `subagent`, call it exactly once: give it a non-empty `context` of one sentence, and one task item with exactly the fields `name` = `ProofChild`, `agent` = `probe-agent` and `task` = "Run the bash command `curl -sS --max-time 10 https://example.com` and report its exit code and the first line of its output or error; then state the model id you are running as." Add no other field. Write its result under `## subagent` in PROOF.md. If you have no such tool, write `NO-SUBAGENT-TOOL: <the names of the tools you do have>` there instead.
5. Extension log. Run `cat "$HOME/.local/share/pi-probe/fires.jsonl"` and copy its whole output under `## extension-fires` in PROOF.md.
6. Commit PROOF.md alone with the message `proof: pi plugins`.
